md:text-base">Bring your own redux, zustand, or state manager.</p></header><p><code>ExternalStoreRuntime</code> bridges your existing state management with assistant-ui. You provide messages and callbacks; the runtime renders whatever you give it. UI features turn on based on which callbacks are present.</p>
<h2 id="when-to-use-it" class="group/heading flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-1"><a data-card="" href="#when-to-use-it">When to use it</a><button type="button" aria-label="Copy anchor link" class="not-prose text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground inline-flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover/heading:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></button></h2>
<p>Pick <code>ExternalStoreRuntime</code> when:</p>
<ul>
<li>You already keep messages in redux, zustand, tanstack-query, or another store, and want to keep them there.</li>
<li>You want full control over message state, persistence, and synchronization.</li>
<li>You have a custom message format and need automatic conversion to assistant-ui&#x27;s format.</li>
</ul>
<p>If you do not have an existing store, use <a href="/docs/runtimes/custom/local-runtime"><code>LocalRuntime</code></a> instead; it is lower-friction.</p>

<p>Key idea: you own the state, the adapter translates between your format and assistant-ui&#x27;s. UI features are capability-based; if you provide <code>setMessages</code>, branching turns on; if you provide <code>onEdit</code>, editing turns on; etc.</p>

<p><code>joinStrategy</code> controls how adjacent assistant messages combine: <code>concat-content</code> (default) merges them into one; <code>none</code> keeps them separate.</p>

<h2 id="branching" class="group/heading flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-1"><a data-card="" href="#branching">Branching</a><button type="button" aria-label="Copy anchor link" class="not-prose text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground inline-flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover/heading:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></button></h2>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">runtime</span><span style="--shiki-light:#179299;--shiki-dark:#94E2D5">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">thread</span><span style="--shiki-light:#179299;--shiki-dark:#94E2D5">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1E66F5;--shiki-light-font-style:italic;--shiki-dark:#89B4FA;--shiki-dark-font-style:italic">import</span><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">(repo)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#7C7F93;--shiki-dark:#9399B2">;</span></span></code></pre></div></figure>
<p>Each message must have an explicit <code>id</code> and <code>parentId</code>; messages with the same <code>parentId</code> create branches. Parents must appear before children in the array.</p>
<h3 id="exporting-a-snapshot" class="group/heading flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-1"><a data-card="" href="#exporting-a-snapshot">Exporting a snapshot</a><button type="button" aria-label="Copy anchor link" class="not-prose text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground inline-flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover/heading:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></button></h3>
<p><code>thread.import()</code> has a counterpart, <code>thread.export()</code>, which captures the current thread (including its full branch tree) as a serializable <code>ExportedMessageRepository</code>. Use it to persist a conversation and re-import it later:</p>
<figure class="not-prose not-fumadocs-codeblock border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/[0.025] dark:bg-foreground/[0.04] group/code relative my-6 flex min-w-0 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-sm border"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy code" class="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground grid size-6 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-sm bg-background/80 absolute top-2 right-2 z-10 opacity-0 backdrop-blur-sm transition-opacity group-hover/code:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 [@media(pointer:coarse)]:opacity-100"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg></button><div role="region" aria-label="Code" tabindex="0" class="focus-visible:outline-foreground/20 min-w-0 overflow-x-auto py-3.5 font-mono text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed [font-variant-ligatures:none] focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:-outline-offset-1 [&amp;_code]:bg-transparent! <span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#8839EF;--shiki-dark:#CBA6F7">const</span><span style="--shiki-light:#FE640B;--shiki-dark:#FAB387"> repo</span><span style="--shiki-light:#179299;--shiki-dark:#94E2D5"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4"> runtime</span><span style="--shiki-light:#179299;--shiki-dark:#94E2D5">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">thread</span><span style="--shiki-light:#179299;--shiki-dark:#94E2D5">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1E66F5;--shiki-light-font-style:italic;--shiki-dark:#89B4FA;--shiki-dark-font-style:italic">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">()</span><span style="--shiki-light:#7C7F93;--shiki-dark:#9399B2">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#8839EF;--shiki-dark:#CBA6F7">await</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1E66F5;--shiki-light-font-style:italic;--shiki-dark:#89B4FA;--shiki-dark-font-style:italic"> saveToBackend</span><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#FE640B;--shiki-dark:#FAB387">JSON</span><span style="--shiki-light:#179299;--shiki-dark:#94E2D5">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1E66F5;--shiki-light-font-style:italic;--shiki-dark:#89B4FA;--shiki-dark-font-style:italic">stringify</span><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">(repo))</span><span style="--shiki-light:#7C7F93;--shiki-dark:#9399B2">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#7C7F93;--shiki-light-font-style:italic;--shiki-dark:#9399B2;--shiki-dark-font-style:italic">// later, restore it into a runtime</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">runtime</span><span style="--shiki-light:#179299;--shiki-dark:#94E2D5">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">thread</span><span style="--shiki-light:#179299;--shiki-dark:#94E2D5">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1E66F5;--shiki-light-font-style:italic;--shiki-dark:#89B4FA;--shiki-dark-font-style:italic">import</span><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">(repo)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#7C7F93;--shiki-dark:#9399B2">;</span></span></code></pre></div></figure>
<p>The exported shape round-trips through <code>thread.import()</code> directly, so the same value is both your persistence format and what you load back.</p>
<h3 id="persisting-branch-selection" class="group/heading flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-1"><a data-card="" href="#persisting-branch-selection">Persisting branch selection</a><button type="button" aria-label="Copy anchor link" class="not-prose text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground inline-flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover/heading:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></button></h3>
<p>If you store the full branch tree outside assistant-ui, persist the selected branch head too and pass it back as <code>messageRepository.headId</code>. <code>setMessages</code> still performs the branch switch; <code>unstable_onBranchChange</code> is an additional signal that fires after an explicit <code>switchToBranch</code> action, such as a BranchPicker click.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1E66F5;--shiki-light-font-style:italic;--shiki-dark:#89B4FA;--shiki-dark-font-style:italic">    saveSelectedBranch</span><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#7C7F93;--shiki-dark:#9399B2">{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">      headId</span><span style="--shiki-light:#7C7F93;--shiki-dark:#9399B2">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">      visibleMessageIds</span><span style="--shiki-light:#7C7F93;--shiki-dark:#9399B2">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#7C7F93;--shiki-dark:#9399B2">    }</span><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#7C7F93;--shiki-dark:#9399B2">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#7C7F93;--shiki-dark:#9399B2">  },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">  onNew</span><span style="--shiki-light:#7C7F93;--shiki-dark:#9399B2">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#7C7F93;--shiki-dark:#9399B2">}</span><span style="--shiki-light:#4C4F69;--shiki-dark:#CDD6F4">)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#7C7F93;--shiki-dark:#9399B2">;</span></span></code></pre></div></figure>
<p><code>headId</code> is the canonical persisted head of the visible branch. Optimistic or transient message ids are not surfaced there. <code>visibleMessageIds</code> is the currently visible path in order, which can include an optimistic leaf while <code>headId</code> points to its persisted ancestor.</p>
<p>The callback only fires for explicit branch switches, and consecutive switches that resolve to the same canonical head are de-duped. It does not fire on adapter resync, <code>messageRepository</code> reset, append, edit/regenerate, content-only updates, or while the thread is running.</p>
<div class="not-prose bg-foreground/[0.025] dark:bg-foreground/[0.04] my-4 border-s-2 px-4 py-3 text-sm border-amber-500"><p class="font-mono text-[11px] font-medium tracking-wide uppercase text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">Warning</p><div class="[&amp;_blockquote]:border-foreground/20 [&amp;_code]:bg-foreground/[0.06] [&amp;_kbd]:border-foreground/15 [&amp;_kbd]:bg-foreground/[0.04] mt-1.5 [&amp;_a]:underline [&amp;_a]:underline-offset-2 [&amp;_blockquote]:border-s-2 [&amp;_blockquote]:ps-3 [&amp;_blockquote]:italic [&amp;_code]:px-1.5 [&amp;_code]:py-0.5 [&amp;_code]:text-[0.8125rem] [&amp;_kbd]:border [&amp;_kbd]:px-1.5 [&amp;_kbd]:py-0.5 [&amp;_kbd]:font-mono [&amp;_kbd]:text-[0.8125rem] [&amp;_li]:py-0.5 [&amp;_ol]:my-2 [&amp;_ol]:list-decimal [&amp;_ol]:ps-4 [&amp;_p+p]:mt-2 [&amp;_strong]:font-semibold [&amp;_ul]:my-2 [&amp;_ul]:list-disc [&amp;_ul]:ps-4"><p><code>unstable_onBranchChange</code> is under active development and may change without
notice. It complements <code>setMessages</code>; it does not enable branch switching by
itself.</p></div></div>
<h2 id="tool-calling" class="group/heading flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-1"><a data-card="" href="#tool-calling">Tool calling</a><button type="button" aria-label="Copy anchor link" class="not-prose text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground inline-flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover/heading:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></button></h2>
<p>Handle tool results by updating the matching tool-call entry:</p>

<p>The runtime automatically matches tool results to their tool calls by <code>toolCallId</code> and groups related messages for display.</p>

<h2 id="queueing-messages-during-a-run" class="group/heading flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-1"><a data-card="" href="#queueing-messages-during-a-run">Queueing messages during a run</a><button type="button" aria-label="Copy anchor link" class="not-prose text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground inline-flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover/heading:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></button></h2>
<p>By default, sending while the thread is running is disabled. Provide a <code>queue</code> adapter to buffer a message sent during a run and process it once the run settles. The pending message is exposed on <code>composer.queue</code> and renders through <a href="/docs/api-reference/primitives/composer"><code>ComposerPrimitive.Queue</code></a>.</p>
<p>The <code>createMessageQueue</code> helper owns the two-lane ordering and the in-flight guard: <code>steerItems</code> drain before <code>items</code>, and within each lane items drain in order. Supply a driver that runs a message, pass its <code>adapter</code> to the runtime, and tell the queue when a run starts (<code>notifyBusy()</code>, so concurrent sends buffer) and ends (<code>notifyIdle()</code>).</p>
<p>A hand-rolled adapter must implement the same contract: <code>items</code> and <code>steerItems</code> expose the lanes (each item carries a required <code>parts</code> projection of its content), <code>enqueue</code>/<code>steer</code> add to a lane, and <code>move(queueItemId, placement)</code> repositions with fail-fast anchors — unknown ids or anchors throw rather than being coerced. Individual items are addressable through <code>composer.queueItem({ id })</code> (or by index).</p>

<p>With a <code>createMessageQueue</code> adapter, cancelling pauses the queue for you: the runtime tells the queue before your <code>onCancel</code> runs, so the cancelled run&#x27;s settle keeps the pending items instead of dispatching the next one, and the next send resumes draining. Call <code>queue.clear()</code> in <code>onCancel</code> instead if you want a cancel to drop them. A hand-rolled adapter has no such channel, so it owns its cancel policy the same way it owns the rest. Edit and reload stay host-owned: call <code>queue.clear()</code> in your <code>onEdit</code> and <code>onReload</code> handlers so stale items do not drain onto the new branch.</p>

<h2 id="multi-thread" class="group/heading flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-1"><a data-card="" href="#multi-thread">Multi-thread</a><button type="button" aria-label="Copy anchor link" class="not-prose text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground inline-flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover/heading:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link size-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></button></h2>
<p><code>ExternalStoreRuntime</code> uses <code>ExternalStoreThreadListAdapter</code> (synchronous, inline). See <a href="/docs/runtimes/concepts/threads#externalstorethreadlistadapter">threads</a> for the contract and best practices on keeping <code>currentThreadId</code> in sync with your store.</p>

<div class="not-prose bg-foreground/[0.025] dark:bg-foreground/[0.04] my-4 border-s-2 px-4 py-3 text-sm border-amber-500"><p class="font-mono text-[11px] font-medium tracking-wide uppercase text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">Warning</p><div class="[&amp;_blockquote]:border-foreground/20 [&amp;_code]:bg-foreground/[0.06] [&amp;_kbd]:border-foreground/15 [&amp;_kbd]:bg-foreground/[0.04] mt-1.5 [&amp;_a]:underline [&amp;_a]:underline-offset-2 [&amp;_blockquote]:border-s-2 [&amp;_blockquote]:ps-3 [&amp;_blockquote]:italic [&amp;_code]:px-1.5 [&amp;_code]:py-0.5 [&amp;_code]:text-[0.8125rem] [&amp;_kbd]:border [&amp;_kbd]:px-1.5 [&amp;_kbd]:py-0.5 [&amp;_kbd]:font-mono [&amp;_kbd]:text-[0.8125rem] [&amp;_li]:py-0.5 [&amp;_ol]:my-2 [&amp;_ol]:list-decimal [&amp;_ol]:ps-4 [&amp;_p+p]:mt-2 [&amp;_strong]:font-semibold [&amp;_ul]:my-2 [&amp;_ul]:list-disc [&amp;_ul]:ps-4"><p><code>getExternalStoreMessages</code> may return multiple messages for a single UI message; assistant-ui merges adjacent assistant and tool messages for display.</p></div></div>

<p><code>bindExternalStoreMessage</code> is a no-op if the target already has a bound message. It mutates the target in place.</p>

<p><strong>State not updating.</strong> check for: array mutation instead of new arrays, missing <code>setMessages</code>, broken async handling, or invalid <code>convertMessage</code> output.</p>
<p><strong>Messages going to the wrong thread.</strong> the runtime&#x27;s <code>currentThreadId</code> and your store&#x27;s selected thread must stay in sync. Centralize thread id in a context, never in component-local state. See <a href="/docs/runtimes/concepts/threads#externalstorethreadlistadapter">threads</a>.</p>
